Sandbox_WE_DeathRetainPercent: Weapon XP kept on owner death (%)
Sandbox_WE_DeathRetainPercent_tooltip: Percentage of weapon XP retained when the character dies. 100 = keep all XP. 0 = lose all XP on death.
Sandbox_WE_XPRequirementGrowthPercent_to: How much more XP each level costs. Example: 7% → level 2 needs 7% more XP than level 1. 0 = flat cost.
Sandbox_WE_XPGainPerLevelPercent: XP gain bonus (% per weapon level)
Sandbox_WE_XPGainPerLevelPercent_tooltip: Bonus XP per weapon level. Example: 1% → level 5 earns +4% more XP per action than level 1. 0 = no bonus.
Sandbox_WE_RepairOnRarityUp_tooltip: When a weapon reaches a new rarity tier, its condition is fully restored. Tiers: Common > Uncommon > Rare > Epic > Legendary > Mythic > Absolute.
Sandbox_WE_XPFromShove: Grant XP for shoving with a weapon
Sandbox_WE_XPFromShove_tooltip: If enabled, weapon XP is granted when shoving a zombie while holding a weapon. Disabled by default — XP is only earned through actual weapon strikes.
Sandbox_WE_ResetRepairsOnRarityUp: Reset repair count on rarity up
Sandbox_WE_ResetRepairsOnRarityUp_toolti: When a weapon reaches a new rarity tier, its repair counter resets to zero, allowing it to be repaired as many times as a newly found weapon.
Sandbox_WE_RepairHeadOnRarityUp_tooltip: Two-part weapons only (axes, spears, etc.). Fully restores the HEAD part condition when a new rarity tier is reached.
Sandbox_WE_ResetHeadRepairsOnRarityUp: Reset HEAD repairs on rarity up
Sandbox_WE_ResetHeadRepairsOnRarityUp_to: Two-part weapons only (axes, spears, etc.). Resets the HEAD part repair counter to zero when a new rarity tier is reached.
Sandbox_WE_SpawnLevelsEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, weapons found in the world receive a starting level based on location type.
Sandbox_WE_SpawnZone_tooltip: Level range for weapons spawning in this location type.
